integrity: The proof is symbolic and self-contained once the standard three-coordinate James norm is fixed; no numerical experiment is used as evidence.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the canonical three-coordinate James section.
It does not determine the constant of the full James space or longer finite sections.
A residual literature-indexing risk remains for older equivalent finite-section terminology.
title: Exact von Neumann–Jordan constant of the three-coordinate James section
